name: Gásakláhko-Vuonatjviken

difficulty.summary: No official difficulty grade found. Treat as a remote, partly exposed section with open fell at the start, poor-visibility risk, descent through birch forest, boggy/overgrown ground and many boardwalks approaching Vuonatjviken.

routeType: mainline hiking stage; roadless endpoint service node; onward Riebnes motorboat connection after section

officialSources.name: STF Kungsleden Kvikkjokk-Ammarnäs route page
officialSources.evidence: Identifies stage 4 / etapp 4 as Gásakláhko-Vuonatjviken, 13 km and 4-6 hours. Describes a few kilometers of open mountain terrain, descent into mountain birch forest near Riebnes, crossing the Arctic Circle shortly before Vuonatjviken, and Vuonatjviken cabin village with tenting possibility and restaurant.
officialSources.caveat: No exact coordinate for the Gásakláhko stage boundary is published.

officialSources.name: Naturkartan / Länsstyrelsen BD78 Piteälven-Jäckvik route
officialSources.evidence: Official broader BD78 route page lists Gásakláhko-Vuonatjviken, 13 km, 4-6 hours. Notes high open terrain around Gásakláhko/Barturtte, difficult painted stone markers in rain/fog, partly overgrown/boggy Vilitjåhkå-Vuonatjviken path with many boardwalks, Arctic Circle crossing before Vuonatjviken, and Riebnes motorboat with no rowboats.
officialSources.caveat: The page covers the broader Piteälven-Jäckvik route and is not section-split geometry.

officialSources.name: Naturkartan BD78 API and GPX
officialSources.evidence: API site 12905 / public GPX exposes generalized broader-route geometry. API updated_at was 2026-04-29T13:54:22 and trail_status_reported_at/comment were null. GPX Vuonatjviken/boat point is around 66.4920400,17.2417961.
officialSources.caveat: Generalized broader-route geometry; not a discrete section-16 geometry and cumulative distance enters the later Riebnes boat segment.

officialSources.name: Naturvårdsverket state trail WFS BD78
officialSources.evidence: Official WFS BD78 linework supports WFS official-distance split 66.5839492,17.2754676 as section start and WFS foot-line end 66.4904687,17.2417888 near Vuonatjviken. WFS Riebnes boat-passage endpoint is near 66.4922764,17.2435414.
officialSources.confidence: high for linework, medium for section split
officialSources.caveat: WFS line is not stage-split; section start derives from section 15 official-distance split.

officialSources.name: Lantmäteriet Sök ortnamn
officialSources.evidence: Confirms Gásakláhko as an official Lule Sami nature/terrain name and Vuonatjviken as an official Swedish settlement name in Arjeplog municipality, Norrbotten.
officialSources.caveat: Place-name points are not trail-stage endpoints.

officialSources.name: OSM / Waymarked relations 18864494 and 18864495
officialSources.evidence: OSM relation 18864494 maps Gásakláhko-Vuonatjviken from OSM campsite boundary 66.6202757,17.2743685 to Vuonatjviken 66.4915145,17.2431982. Relation 18864495 starts exactly at that Vuonatjviken point.
officialSources.caveat: OSM relation 18864494 computes about 16.1 km while tagged/official distance is 13 km; geometry lane concluded OSM starts too far north at the campsite.

officialSources.name: Hornavan-Sädvajaure nature reserve / Skyddad Natur
officialSources.evidence: Rules lane point sampling found southern/last-kilometers section overlap with Hornavan-Sädvajaure fjällurskog nature reserve and Natura 2000 SCI SE0820123 near the approach to Vuonatjviken.
officialSources.caveat: Point-sampling evidence only; final selected-line polygon overlay remains required.

Lantmäteriet Gásakláhko is a terrain-name/text-placement point, not a route endpoint.

For facilities/access, use Vuonatjvikens Stugby service node and Riebnes east boat landing rather than only the WFS foot endpoint.

endpointGapNotes: OSM/Waymarked 18864494 starts about 4.214 km north along WFS / 4.231 km into OSM relation before the WFS split.
OSM relation 18864494 computes about 16.1 km while tagged 13 km, while section 15 OSM relation computes about 14.5 km while tagged 19 km.
WFS foot end to OSM shared Vuonatjviken endpoint is about 132 m; WFS foot end to WFS boat endpoint is about 216 m.
OSM relation 18864495 starts exactly where 18864494 ends, so OSM has clean Vuonatjviken continuity.

commuteAccess.summary: The section start is a remote wilderness boundary with no direct access. Vuonatjviken is an endpoint service/accommodation node but is roadless and not public transport. Southbound public transport is only practical after Riebnes boat plus more hiking to Jäckvik.

startClosestCommutePoint.caveats: Not public transport and not a road trailhead. Access is by hiking, booked boat, snowmobile/ATV/local service or helicopter.

wildCamping.summary: Official sources describe good camping around Gásakláhko/Barturtte in good weather and tent sites/water along the broader route. Field reports support camping near Bartek/Gåbdåk. Vuonatjviken offers tenting/service-node camping by arrangement/policy.
wildCamping.caveats: Highland start is exposed with little shelter; final approach intersects Hornavan-Sädvajaure reserve/Natura context where general reserve rules and fire bans still apply.

closuresAndReroutes.caveats: No section-specific closure/reroute found. Naturkartan API trail_status fields were null. Recheck before publication.

terrainAndWeather: Open high ground around Gásakláhko/Barturtte is exposed; rain/fog can make painted stone markers hard to see.
If the WFS split is used as section start, some of the broader Gásakláhko plateau hazard belongs to section 15 rather than section 16.
Vilitjåhkå-Vuonatjviken is partly overgrown and boggy with many boardwalks.
Older field reports mention damaged/collapsed small bridges, but current condition was not confirmed.
The Arctic Circle is crossed shortly before Vuonatjviken; marker visibility and exact sign position vary by report.

reserveVisitorRules.summary: Hornavan-Sädvajaure visitor rules allow walking, tenting, fires, berry/mushroom picking, fishing and hunting subject to general laws; damaging plants/animals is not allowed. Fire permission is overridden by active fire bans.
reserveVisitorRules.caveats: Summarized from reserve page; final app rules should use normalized reserve regulation data.

dogsReindeerHuntingFishing.summary: Norrbotten is reindeer-herding area. Länsstyrelsen notice 2026-02-05 says dogs must be leashed or enclosed where reindeer are present and herding is permitted unless otherwise allowed. Small-game hunting and fishing rules are date/place-specific and require NatureIT/Länsstyrelsen/Arjeplog permit rechecks.
dogsReindeerHuntingFishing.caveats: Exact sameby/hunting/fishing overlays were not normalized in this research-only pass.

currentnessNotes: 2026-04-22 Länsstyrelsen stopped winter-trail checks because spring warmth degraded snow/ice; weak ice/open water risk.
2026-03-27 Länsstyrelsen noted changed snow/ice conditions, weak lake ice, open leads and variable snow depth.
On 2026-04-29 Länsstyrelsen pages showed an SMHI banner for wind on bare mountain in Norrbotten; treat as dynamic, not persistent metadata.
Riebnes commercial motorboat is just beyond the endpoint and should be confirmed directly with Vuonatjvikens Stugby before relying on onward travel.

sourceContradictions.details: Official STF/Naturkartan distance/time supports a 13 km Gásakláhko-Vuonatjviken section and the WFS official-distance split at 66.5839492,17.2754676, while OSM/Wikivoyage/Mapcarta place a Gásakláhko campsite around 66.6202912,17.2744719 and OSM relation 18864494 starts there.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use WFS split as provisional start if preserving official distances; keep OSM campsite as section-15 facility and caveat.

sourceContradictions.details: OSM/Waymarked relation 18864494 computes about 16.1 km while tagged/official distance is 13 km. Truncating at WFS split leaves about 11.9 km, closer to official distance.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Do not import OSM relation 18864494 as section geometry without boundary correction/source-policy decision.

sourceContradictions.details: WFS foot-line end, WFS boat endpoint, Naturkartan GPX endpoint, OSM section join and Vuonatjvikens Stugby service node differ by about 50-215 m.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Model an endpoint zone and keep route endpoint, boat landing and service node distinct in normalization.

sourceContradictions.topic: Official versus route-app facility certainty at Vuonatjviken
sourceContradictions.details: Official sources confirm accommodation/tenting/restaurant, while route apps mention extra provisions/gas/prices/times. The latter are volatile and not fully official.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Import service node and restaurant/tenting caveats; keep shop/resupply pending unless current operator confirms.

sourceContradictions.details: Point sampling indicates Hornavan-Sädvajaure reserve/Natura overlap only on the southern/last-kilometers approach; no full polygon overlay was run.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Attach as research caveat and run selected-line overlay before rules normalization.

sourceContradictions.details: Official Gåbdåk bridge is high confidence, but OSM small bridge and older damaged-bridge field reports are uncertain.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Import official bridge if taxonomy supports it; keep OSM small bridge pending and recheck current condition.

sourceContradictions.details: Fire bans, weather, snow/ice, Riebnes boat operations, service opening, hunting/fishing closures and dog/reindeer restrictions are date-sensitive.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Recheck all currentness items before public/runtime use.

agents.result: Confirmed official stage name, distance/time, description, Vuonatjviken services, Riebnes boat context, Arctic Circle note and official support for WFS split over OSM campsite.
Documented WFS, Naturkartan GPX, OSM/Waymarked and endpoint-zone geometry, confirming OSM mis-split and WFS split recommendation.
Identified highland camping note, Arctic Circle marker candidate, bridges, Bartek/Gåbdåk water/camping zone, Vuonatjviken service node/amenities and Riebnes boat landing; documented suppressions.
Confirmed roadless endpoint/access context, Vuonatjviken private/local access, Riebnes boat and Jäckvik public bus exit after boat+hike.
Documented terrain, water, camping, route-finding, Arctic Circle visibility, Vuonatjviken facilities and field-distance/boundary caveats.
Found Hornavan-Sädvajaure reserve/Natura point-sampled overlap near Vuonatjviken and documented current notices, dog/reindeer, hunting/fishing/fire and Riebnes boat risk.
